Your business profile is set up. Use the.st: Profaele ea khoebo ea hau e se e lokile. Sebelisa lenane la ho seta ho fetola lintlha — liphetoho mona ha li bolokoe.
Your business profile is set up. Use the.nso: Profaele ya kgwebo ya gago e šetše e lokile. Šomiša lenaneo la go beakanya go fetola dintlha — diphetogo mo ga di bolokwe.
Your business profile is set up. Use the.tn: Porofaele ya kgwebo ya gago e setse e siamile. Dirisa lenaane la go baakanya go fetola dintlha — diphetogo fa ga di bolokwe.
Your business profile is set up. Use the.ts: Profayili ya bindzu ra wena se yi lulamisiwile. Tirhisa nongonoko wo lulamisa ku cinca vuxokoxoko — ku cinca laha a ku hlayisiwi.
Your business profile is set up. Use the.ve: Phrofayili ya bindu ḽanu yo no lugiswa. Shumisani mutevhe wa u lugisa u shandukisa zwidodombedzwa — tshanduko hafha a dzi vhulungwi.
Your business profile is set up. Use the.ss: Iphrofayela yebhizinisi yakho isilungisiwe. Sebentisa luhla lwekuseta kushintja imininingwane — tingucuko lapha atigcinwa.

Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.af: Kies hoe kansellasies en wegblyers hanteer word. Jy kan dit later in Instellings verfyn.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.zu: Khetha ukuthi ukukhansela nokungafiki kuphathwa kanjani. Ungakulungisa lokhu kamuva kuzilungiselelo.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.xh: Khetha indlela yokuphatha ukurhoxisa nokungafiki. Ungayilungisa le nto kamva kwizicwangciso.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.st: Khetha hore na ho hlakoloa le ho se fihle ho sebetsoa joang. O ka e lokisa hamorao ho Litlhophiso.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.nso: Kgetha gore go phumolwa le go se fihle go swarwa bjang. O ka e lokiša ka morago go Dipeakanyo.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.tn: Tlhopha gore go phimolwa le go sa goroge go tshwarwa jang. O ka e baakanya morago mo dithulaganyong.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.ts: Hlawula ndlela leyi ku khansela ni ku nga fiki swi lawuriwaka ha yona. U nga swi lulamisa endzhaku eka swilungiselelo.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.ve: Nangani uri u khansela na u sa swika zwi farwa hani. Ni nga zwi lugisa nga murahu kha nzudzanyo.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.ss: Khetsa kutsi kukhansela nekungafiki kuphatfwa njani. Ungakuhlela loku kamuva kutinhlelo.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.fr: Choisissez comment les annulations et les absences sont gérées. Vous pourrez affiner cela plus tard dans les paramètres.
Choose how cancellations and no-shows ar.ar: اختر كيفية التعامل مع الإلغاءات وعدم الحضور. يمكنك ضبط ذلك لاحقًا في الإعدادات.

No fee while payment is still pending..af: Geen heffing terwyl betaling nog hangende is nie.
No fee while payment is still pending..st: Ha ho tefiso ha kopo ea tefo e sa emetse.
No fee while payment is still pending..nso: Ga go na tefiso mola tefo e sa emetše.
No fee while payment is still pending..tn: Ga go na tuelo fa tuelo e sa letile.
No fee while payment is still pending..ts: A ku na hakelo loko hakelo yi ha yimele.
No fee while payment is still pending..ve: A hu na mbadelo musi mbadelo i tshee yo lindela.
No fee while payment is still pending..fr: Aucuns frais tant que le paiement est encore en attente.
No fee while payment is still pending..ar: لا توجد رسوم ما دام الدفع معلّقًا.

You're within the grace period — no canc.af: Jy is binne die genadeperiode — geen kansellasiefooi nie.
You're within the grace period — no canc.zu: Usenkathini yesikhathi sokuxolelwa — ayikho imali yokukhansela.
You're within the grace period — no canc.st: U ka hare ho nako ea mohau — ha ho tefiso ea ho hlakola.
You're within the grace period — no canc.nso: O ka gare ga nako ya mohau — ga go na tefiso ya go phumola.
You're within the grace period — no canc.tn: O mo nakong ya tshwarelo — ga go na tuelo ya go phimola.
You're within the grace period — no canc.ts: U le ka nkarhi wa ntsetselelo — a ku na hakelo yo khansela.
You're within the grace period — no canc.ve: Ni ngomu ha tshifhinga tsha tsherwa — a hu na mbadelo ya u khansela.
You're within the grace period — no canc.fr: Vous êtes dans la période de grâce — aucuns frais d’annulation.
You're within the grace period — no canc.ar: أنت ضمن فترة السماح — لا رسوم إلغاء.

No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.af: Geen heffing nie — die diensverskaffer het hierdie afspraak verskuif.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.zu: Ayikho imali — umhlinzeki usikushintshe lesi sikhathi.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.xh: Akukho ntlawulo — umboneleli uluyelelise olu cwangciso.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.st: Ha ho tefiso — mofani o fetotse nako ea kopano ena.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.nso: Ga go na tefiso — mohlami o fetotše nako ya kopano ye.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.tn: Ga go na tuelo — moabi o fetotse nako ya kopano e.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.ts: A ku na hakelo — muhakeri u cincile nkarhi wa nhlangano lowu.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.ve: A hu na mbadelo — muṋe wa tshumelo o shandukisa tshifhinga tsha hoyu nḓaano.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.fr: Aucuns frais — le prestataire a reporté ce rendez-vous.
No fee — the provider rescheduled this a.ar: لا رسوم — أعاد مقدّم الخدمة جدولة هذا الموعد.

This provider's policy has no cancellati.af: Hierdie diensverskaffer se beleid het geen kansellasiestraf nie.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.zu: Inqubomgomo yalo mhlinzeki ayinayo inhlawulo yokukhansela.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.xh: Umgaqo walo mboneleli awunayo isohlwayo sokurhoxisa.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.st: Leano la mofani enoa ha le na kotlo ea ho hlakola.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.nso: Pholisi ya mohlami yo ga e na kotlo ya go phumola.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.tn: Pholisi ya moabi yo ga e na kotlhao ya go phimola.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.ts: Nawu wa muhakeri loyi a wu na ndziho yo khansela.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.ve: Mulao wa muṋe wa tshumelo hoyu a u na ndafulo ya u khansela.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.fr: La politique de ce prestataire ne prévoit aucune pénalité d’annulation.
This provider's policy has no cancellati.ar: سياسة مقدّم الخدمة هذا لا تتضمن غرامة إلغاء.

The provider will cancel without a custo.xh: Umboneleli uya kurhoxisa ngaphandle kwesohlwayo somthengi.
The provider will cancel without a custo.st: Mofani o tla hlakola ntle le kotlo ea moreki.
The provider will cancel without a custo.nso: Mohlami o tla phumola ntle le kotlo ya moreki.
The provider will cancel without a custo.tn: Moabi o tla phimola ntle le kotlhao ya moreki.
The provider will cancel without a custo.ts: Muhakeri u ta khansela handle ka ndziho ya xavi.
The provider will cancel without a custo.ve: Muṋe wa tshumelo u ḓo khansela nga nnda ha ndafulo ya mutengi.
The provider will cancel without a custo.fr: Le prestataire annulera sans pénalité pour le client.
The provider will cancel without a custo.ar: سيلغي مقدّم الخدمة دون غرامة على العميل.

If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.af: As jy by die lokaal betaal, word terugbetalings direk met die diensverskaffer hanteer — nie na jou kaart of beursie nie.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.zu: Uma ukhokha endaweni, imbuyiselo iphathwa ngqo nomhlinzeki — hhayi ekhadini noma esikhwameni sakho.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.xh: Ukuba uhlawula kwindawo, iimbuyekezo zilawulwa ngqo kunye nomboneleli — hayi kwikhadi okanye kwisipaji sakho.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.st: Haeba u lefa sebakeng, dipusetso di sebetswa ka kotloloho le mofani — eseng kareteng kapa sepacheng sa hau.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.nso: Ge o lefa lefelong, dipusetso di swarwa ka go lebanya le mohlami — e sego kareteng goba sepacheng sa gago.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.tn: Fa o duela mo lefelong, dipusetso di tshwarwa ka tlhamalalo le moabi — e seng mo karating kgotsa mo sepaching sa gago.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.ts: Loko u hakela endlwini, mimbuyelo yi lawuriwa hi ku kongoma na muhakeri — ku nga ri eka khadi kumbe xikhwama xa wena.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.ve: Arali ni badela fhethu, mbadelo dzi vhuyisedzwaho dzi farwa nga u livhana na muṋe wa tshumelo — hu si kha khadi kana tshikhwama tshanu.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.ss: Uma ukhokha endzaweni, imbuyiselo iphatfwa ngco nalomhlinzeki — hhayi ekhadini noma esikhwameni sakho.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.fr: Si vous payez sur place, les remboursements se font directement avec le prestataire — pas vers votre carte ou portefeuille.
If you pay at the venue, refunds are han.ar: إذا دفعت في المكان، تُعالج المبالغ المستردة مباشرة مع مقدّم الخدمة — وليس إلى بطاقتك أو محفظتك.

This provider does not charge cancellati.af: Hierdie diensverskaffer hef nie kansellasiestraf nie. Bedrae wat aanlyn betaal is, word na jou Beautonomi-beursie terugbetaal.
This provider does not charge cancellati.zu: Lo mhlinzeki akakhokhisi inhlawulo yokukhansela. Izimali ezikhokhwe ku-inthanethi zibuyiselwa esikhwameni sakho se-Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.xh: Lo mboneleli akakhokhisi isohlwayo sokurhoxisa. Iimali ezihlawulwe kwi-intanethi zibuyiselwa kwisipaji sakho se-Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.st: Mofani enoa ha a lefise dikotlo tsa ho hlakola. Ditefiso tse lefiloeng inthaneteng di khutlisetswa sepacheng sa hau sa Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.nso: Mohlami yo ga a lefise dikotlo tša go phumola. Ditefiso tšeo di lefilwego inthaneteng di bušetšwa sepacheng sa gago sa Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.tn: Moabi yo ga a duele dikotlhao tsa go phimola. Dituelo tse di duelweng mo inthaneteng di busediwa mo sepaching sa gago sa Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.ts: Muhakeri loyi a nga hakerisi swidziho swo khansela. Mali leyi hakeriweke eka inthanete yi vuyiseriwa eka xikhwama xa wena xa Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.ve: Muṋe wa tshumelo hoyu ha badelisi ndafulo dza u khansela. Masheleni o badelwaho kha inthanethe a vhuyisedzwa kha tshikhwama tshanu tsha Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.ss: Lomhlinzeki akakhokhisi inhlawulo yekukhansela. Imali lekhokhwe ku-inthanethi ibuyiselwa esikhwameni sakho se-Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.fr: Ce prestataire ne facture pas de pénalités d’annulation. Les montants payés en ligne sont remboursés sur votre portefeuille Beautonomi.
This provider does not charge cancellati.ar: لا يفرض مقدّم الخدمة هذا غرامات إلغاء. تُرد المبالغ المدفوعة عبر الإنترنت إلى محفظة Beautonomi.
